scope: Hub integration and read-only app/view/UI acceptance review
notes: Eight additional findings came from direct source-contract review. This is not a claim that nine automated tests failed. Export syntax and audio event mismatches were also seen by other team members and must be counted only once in a combined issue ledger. A test-fixture expectation adjustment is not a product defect.

findings.method: Pinned live Hub harness startup test
findings.finding: Final bundled classic script contained export syntax, producing Unexpected token export and preventing hello/readiness.
findings.status: Fixed by root using Bun IIFE export; live harness then passed.

findings.finding: App debug snapshot and dev summary called adapter diagnostics() although the contract exposes diagnostics as an object.

findings.method: Source event-producer/consumer review; independent research agent also found audio mismatch
findings.finding: boss-hit, boss-phase, emitter-break and saucer-hit were absent from audio aliases and visual event routing, losing corresponding hit/destruction/phase feedback.
findings.status: Audio fixed by research agent; view fixed by root. Native asset/audio regression now covers exact simulation event names and throttling.

findings.finding: Victory immediately opened results and continued drawing the intact hp0 flagship, omitting defended-planet celebration.
findings.status: Root added 2.4-second standalone planet/fireworks sequence and hides defeated hull.

findings.finding: Pickup life was never rendered and pickup-expire was ignored, so missed salvage disappeared without warning or expiry feedback.
findings.status: Root added warning indicator and expiry burst.

findings.finding: Server controller ignored input correctly, but the app still polled pads and sampled game.players before handing it to the adapter.
findings.status: Root skips app local input sampling on server sessions.

findings.finding: Controller range changes dispatch synthetic input; its listener forced activity(keyboard), switching prompts despite pad interaction.
findings.status: Root changed listener to preserve existing primary device.

findings.finding: Dev text seed input continued before cancel/back handling, making Escape/Circle ineffective while that row had focus.
findings.status: Root handles cancel before the text-input editing skip.

findings.finding: Non-finished Hub end reasons can leave shared world status playing; generic results therefore falsely said all deployments were exhausted after host-left/void/sat-out/session-ended.
findings.status: Fixed by root: onEnd retains sessionEndReason and non-finished Hub results show ROUND VOID / ROUND CLOSED with truthful explanation; authoritative world remains unchanged.

verification.audioEventRegression: Passed: exact boss-hit/core, boss-phase/heavy, emitter-break/heavy, saucer-hit/extra routes and repeated-core throttling.
